evaluator.label: Claude Opus 5
evaluator.policy: Every assessment is produced by a fresh agent running this model, working only inside its isolated evaluator workspace. An assessment's evaluatorModel must equal this value; bench score refuses to register anything else unless run with --allow-evaluator-model.

anchors.0: Missing, broken, disconnected, or contradicted by direct evidence.
anchors.1: Present but generic: not recognizably the assigned instrument, or presentation-only where behavior is required.
anchors.2: Correct structure, but measurements fall outside the specified tolerance, required landmarks are absent, or the behavior is materially incomplete.
anchors.3: Every specified measurement inside tolerance and every required element present, with detail simplified in ways a knowledgeable player would notice.
anchors.4: Matches the reference: measurements inside tolerance, nothing missing and nothing forbidden present, and detail a knowledgeable player would not distinguish from the hardware.

ratingScale.note: Rate against the measurement where one is specified, not against impression. Criteria marked scoring:"computed" are not rated at all — report their measurements and the score is derived, so no judgment enters where the spec already gives ground truth.

runAxis.note: Panel fidelity is scored once, against the final sealed artifact, because the phases are cumulative and it was previously measured three times at three different resolutions. A regression introduced in a later phase is caught here because the final artifact is the regressed one.

measurements.note: A keybed whose keys do not lay out inside it is not a keybed, however correct the key count is.
A deck allocation this far out of tolerance pushes controls off the chassis.

hardGate.note: Gates key on individual measurements rather than the criterion score: averaging five measurements dilutes one catastrophic failure into a passing number. Tripping any gate caps panel fidelity at scoreCap.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry
criteria.guidance: Measure against specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json at 1440x900: deck/keybed vertical allocation (0.54/0.46 +/-0.025), instrument width fraction (0.88-0.97), and the six horizontal section fractions in order. Report the measured numbers. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated: report the numbers and the score follows.

measurements.label: Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement
criteria.guidance: Every knob, button, fader, drawbar, LED and display in sectionLandmarks.required is present, in its section, and nothing in forbidden appears. Count the controls. Reachability is measured, not inferred. For every control, hit-test a 5x5 grid of points across its bounding box with document.elementFromPoint at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled; the control counts as reachable only if at least one grid point resolves to that control or a descendant of it. Do NOT use a framework click helper: Playwright's click() programmatically scrolls an overflow:hidden container and reports success for a control the user can never reach. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated.

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity
criteria.guidance: Key count and split for the assigned variant, black/white width and height ratios, keys laid out inside the keybed bounds, pressed state. Count the keys whose box falls inside the keybed. This criterion is COMPUTED from your measurements, not rated: report the numbers and the score follows.

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
criteria.guidance: Sample the rendered page and compare against specs referenceColors. Report, for each of the five reference colours, whether the nearest rendered surface is within a CIE76 deltaE of 12 — count how many of the five match.

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
criteria.guidance: Knob/fader/drawbar caps, LED ladders, silkscreen legends legible at rendered size, OLED treatment, and surface materials. Judged — these are not reducible to a measurement.

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
criteria.guidance: Does the panel show what the instrument is doing: control positions track their parameters, LEDs follow the active layer/section, displays read live values. Drive controls and observe.

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
criteria.guidance: At 390x844 the instrument stays recognizable and usable rather than collapsing or clipping.

criteria.label: Piano voice
criteria.guidance: One dependable, musical basic piano voice across the keybed; level, decay and release behave.

criteria.label: Declared source honesty
criteria.guidance: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares what actually produces sound. Verify by exercising the build, not by reading the declaration.

criteria.label: Input coverage
criteria.guidance: Pointer, computer keyboard and Web MIDI all reach one note lifecycle. Exercise each.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle
criteria.guidance: Velocity mapping, sustain, deterministic voice stealing, all-notes-off on blur/disconnect/unmount.

criteria.label: Control feel & decorative boundary
criteria.guidance: Controls move and report state; controls that do nothing are visibly inert. Never fake success.

criteria.label: Required Phase 1 controls present
criteria.guidance: Every control the Phase 1 contract requires exists on the panel and is identifiable.

criteria.label: Required piano feature IDs
criteria.guidance: The Phase 1 piano feature IDs are implemented and exercised in the running build.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
criteria.guidance: Anything declared unimplemented really is, and nothing undeclared is missing. Check IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json against behaviour.

criteria.label: Instrument breadth & character
criteria.guidance: Grand, upright, electric, clavinet and digital are audibly distinct, not one voice relabelled.

criteria.label: Effect audibility & correctness
criteria.guidance: Each effect is individually audible and behaves like its namesake. A/B each one.

criteria.label: Signal graph & gain staging
criteria.guidance: One shared context, per-layer buses, sane gain staging, no clipping under load.

criteria.label: Two-layer piano behaviour
criteria.guidance: Layer A/B split, level, octave and focus reach the audio graph and the panel reflects them.

criteria.label: Detailed piano controls
criteria.guidance: String resonance, pedal noise, dynamics, timbre and soft release measurably change rendered signal.

criteria.label: Input reliability & failure behaviour
criteria.guidance: Inputs stay reliable under stress; failures degrade visibly rather than silently.

criteria.label: Required piano instruments
criteria.guidance: Every instrument the Phase 2 contract requires is present and selectable, and actually loads.

criteria.label: Required effect units and types
criteria.guidance: Every effect unit and every listed type within it is present and reachable from the panel.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
criteria.guidance: Anything declared unimplemented really is, and nothing undeclared is missing.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
criteria.guidance: Organ, Piano and Synth are genuinely different engines, not one engine with presets.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
criteria.guidance: Every engine inherits the shared effects graph and routes correctly across layers.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load
criteria.guidance: Latency, polyphony and stability while actually playing.

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
criteria.guidance: Canonical state saves, loads and round-trips without loss; the dirty flag is truthful.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
criteria.guidance: Required hardware bindings, wheels, pedals and Live Mode behave.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
criteria.guidance: Split points, scenes, transpose and panic behave correctly across all three engines at once.

criteria.label: Organ system
criteria.guidance: Drawbars, models, percussion, rotary, vibrato.

criteria.label: Synth system
criteria.guidance: Oscillators, filter, envelopes, LFO, unison, arpeggiator.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
criteria.guidance: Layer and split handling, scenes, and morph sources reaching their destinations.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
criteria.guidance: Program storage, recall, page navigation and Live Mode.

scoringKinds.computed: Derived from reported measurements. band: full credit within tolerance of target, decaying linearly to zero at decay x tolerance. range: full credit inside [minimum,maximum], decaying by the same rule using the half-width. ratio: (value/denominator)^curve as a percentage (curve defaults to 1). penaltyCount: 100 minus penaltyEach per occurrence, floored at 0.
